Hi all —

Thanks Sam — answering inline and attaching a sanitized sample export (audit_logs_sample.csv).

1) SOC 2 status: Redwood has completed SOC 2 Type 1 and is in final stages of our Type 2 audit; expected attestation date is 2026-09-01. For procurement you can reference: "Redwood Inference — SOC 2 Type 1 completed; Type 2 attestation expected 2026-09-01. Control descriptions and mapping available on request."

2) Immutability:
  - We support export to S3 with Object Lock enabled by customer (we provide signed export manifests). Internally, our primary logging pipeline is append-only and we stream to a long-term immutable store where deletes are gated by retention policy and audit.
  - For dedicated/private deployments we can configure write-once retention using S3 Object Lock/Legal Hold.

3) Retention & exports:
  - Retention: configurable per-tenant 30/90/365/540/730 days. For enterprise contracts we support custom retention (e.g., 13 months) via an export workflow.
  - Exports: ad-hoc via REST API (GET /v1/audit-exports?start=...&end=...) or scheduled S3 exports. Exports include a manifest and gzipped CSVs containing fields outlined below. Payloads: we do not include raw sensitive request bodies by default; metadata (request id, endpoint, timestamp, response code, user id, tenant id) included. We can enable additional fields per contract with redaction rules applied.

4) Access controls / attribution:
  - Admin actions: every console/admin action is logged with actor_id (email), IP, timestamp, and action detail. Role changes are logged as diffs with before/after.

Log schema (sample columns in audit_logs_sample.csv): timestamp, request_id, tenant_id, user_id, actor_email, endpoint, method, status_code, latency_ms, resource_id, action, changes_redacted

Sample API call to start an export (example):
  curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit-exports" -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"start":"2025-06-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-06-30T23:59:59Z","format":"csv","destination":{"type":"s3","bucket":"acme-audit-exports","prefix":"redwood/"}}'

I've attached a sanitized CSV (no PII) and a short PDF summary of our SOC 2 posture. Happy to hop on the follow-up call Wed 7/8 10:00am PT — that works for me.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
